correctness.rationale: This is the smooth quotient of the blow-up, not the singular torus quotient. There are three fixed points on E and 81 on E^4, with scalar tangent action. The projectivized action fixes each exceptional P^3 pointwise and acts in its normal direction by a primitive cube root; taking the cube of the transverse coordinate gives the local quotient chart. The exterior cohomology of E^4 has character zeta^(p-q) on type (p,q). Each center adds one invariant class in each of types (1,1),(2,2),(3,3). For the finite quotient map, higher direct images of the rational constant sheaf vanish by finite fibers and proper base change; the invariant part of the direct image is the constant sheaf on the quotient, and averaging is exact. Thus the quotient pullback gives the invariant rational cohomology, respecting Hodge type. Summing gives the stated Betti vector, topological Euler 297 and holomorphic Euler -3. One check on the complex-oriented signature is the Lefschetz decomposition of H^4: L^2 H^0 contributes +1, L times primitive (1,1) contributes -(97-1), and primitive (2,2) contributes +(117-97), totaling -75. For simple connectivity, the affine lifts (lambda,rho) each fix lambda/(1-zeta), which lifts a center. They fix its projectivized tangent in the affine blow-up and generate the full semidirect product together with (0,rho). The locally finite blow-up is simply connected, by removing balls about the lifted centers and gluing simply connected disk bundles along S^7. Equivalently, off the exceptionals the quotient has as universal cover C^4 minus the locally finite centers, which is simply connected by general position; gluing the quotient disk bundles over P^3 kills the cyclic local stabilizers carried by their lens-space boundaries, including the conjugacy classes of all (lambda,rho). Either route yields trivial pi_1. Independent wedge and signature arithmetic replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 4; this checks numbers, not the topology. The packaged verifier was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The smooth fourfold matters independently as an effective-nonvanishing counterexample. Its full Hodge dimensions and simple connectivity together provide specific topology against which related resolutions or variants can be compared. In particular, the large new second Betti number, odd-degree cohomology and trivial fundamental group distinguish information not supplied by the construction's line-bundle arguments. The calculation is bounded to this natural model, not a claim about all quotient resolutions, integral torsion, or the cohomology ring.
